description: An item macro that returns quote do def a(), do: 1; def b(), do: 2 end is refused: 'item macro expansion returned a non-definition call'. A list of quotes works. item_macro_fragment_root (src/compiler2/quoted_expander.rs) takes a list as items and a __block__ as one item. A __block__ returned at item level is its statements, each an item, as in Elixir; Elixir's own defexception returns a block. Drive test and a fixture on interp, run and build.
title: An item macro's block is its definitions
